title: CloseInbox input
description: Close an inbox. Posts to it are refused; the messages it holds stay until they expire.

inbox.messaging.Address.title: Address
inbox.messaging.Address.description: The address of an inbox: `agent:<host>/<session-name>` or `human:<name>`. `group:<name>` is reserved; version 1 opens no group inbox, and a sender that addresses several inboxes posts one envelope to each under one `thread`.
